title: datura dolichocarpa

This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to act as a sedative and antispasmodic, which can help to reduce anxiety and ease muscle tension. The therapeutic actions of Datura dolichocarpa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which have been shown to have sedative, anticholinergic, and antispasmodic properties. However, it's worth noting that Datura dolichocarpa is a highly toxic plant and should be handled with caution, as its bioactive constituents can also have adverse effects in large doses.
